utility.ui.After both the chosen number of member messages and the minimum time interval, Pinchora posts a fresh copy and removes the old one. Counts are batched to prevent bursts. It needs Manage Messages.
utility.ui.Cron: minute hour day month weekday
utility.ui.Enable Messages to use sticky posts and AFK notices.
utility.ui.Every {messages} messages and at least {seconds} seconds · {count} counted
utility.ui.IANA time zones follow daylight saving changes automatically.
utility.ui.Keep an important note visible, or send a message at the right time. AFK notices are set by each member with /afk set.
utility.ui.Paused: Pinchora no longer has the required channel permissions.
utility.ui.Paused: delivery could not be confirmed. Check the channel before resuming to avoid a duplicate.
utility.ui.Send once, every few minutes, daily, weekly, or with a five-field cron pattern. Choose an IANA time zone for the server's local time.
utility.ui.Use * or one number in each field. Example: 0 9 * * 1
